snippet.title: Standard Human Pizza Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Standard Human Pizza here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4628760/Standard_Human_Pizza/

Pizza simulator meets horror. Serve the monsters, survive the anomalies, and use secret ingredients to exterminate your clientele.

Manage a pizzeria in an isolated village and prepare recipes for your non-human customers. They’re mostly friendly, but get things wrong and things might get strange.

Survive anomalies. Naturally, a pizzeria would attract the strangest kinds.

The customer is always right... until they're dead.

Discover why you have been chosen. Explore the village, talk to other humans, and discover why the monsters are keeping you prisoner.
